operators.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_squeeze
semantics: Move input from CPU to CUDA.
Compute adaptive average pooling with output size (1,1): for each batch b and channel c, output[b,c] = mean over height and width of input[b,c,:,:].
Squeeze the last two dimensions, resulting in shape [B, C].
Return CUDA float32 tensor.

operators.name: triplet_margin_loss
semantics: Given anchor, positive, negative tensors of shape [B, C], compute pairwise distances: d_pos = sqrt(sum((anchor - positive)^2, dim=1) + eps), d_neg = sqrt(sum((anchor - negative)^2, dim=1) + eps).
Compute loss for each sample: max(d_pos - d_neg + margin, 0).
Apply reduction='mean' over batch (default as in reference).
Return scalar CUDA float32 tensor.
